svg.title: Three kinds of silence
svg.desc: The sentence the PoC no longer fires can be true because the PoC never hit, because the build was broken, or because every run exited its declared silent_exit with an unchanged regression set. Only the third lane can enter the three-leg conjunction that yields CLOSED.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, 'Courier New', monospace
'Space Grotesk', 'PingFang SC', 'Hiragino Sans GB', 'Microsoft YaHei', system-ui, sans-serif

svg.text: The same silence, three different worlds

text.font-family: 'Space Grotesk', 'PingFang SC', 'Hiragino Sans GB', 'Microsoft YaHei', system-ui, sans-serif

svg.text: Only one of these lanes is evidence that the vulnerability is gone.

svg.text: Only lane 03 can be called a fix — and only with all three legs.

text.font-family: 'Space Grotesk', 'PingFang SC', 'Hiragino Sans GB', 'Microsoft YaHei', system-ui, sans-serif

svg.text: Anything else stops at INCONCLUSIVE, with the unobservable run recorded, instead of quietly becoming "fixed".

svg.text: pocgate books silence against the declared exit; a crash and a fix never share a state.
